slide2.title: IPO DETAILS
lines: SK Hynix raised $26.5 billion in its US IPO, making it one of the largest IPOs in history.
The company's stock soared in its Nasdaq debut, with over 8% drop in shares on July 14.
The IPO was oversubscribed, with investors seeking to cash in on the AI-fueled memory chip boom.
The $26.5 billion raised will be used to fund the company's growth and expansion plans.

slide3.title: MARKET IMPACT
lines: The IPO is expected to have a significant impact on the market, with many investors looking to capitalize on the growth of the memory chip industry.
The success of the IPO could also lead to more companies listing on the Nasdaq in the future.
The AI-fueled memory chip boom is driving growth in the industry, with many companies looking to innovate and expand their offerings.

slide1.headline: The Call for AI Regulation
slide1.subtitle: Protesters Demand Action from OpenAI and Google DeepMind

slide2.title: PROTEST DETAILS
lines: Over 200 protesters marched to the offices of OpenAI and Google DeepMind, demanding AI regulation and a pause in the AI race.
The protesters are concerned about the potential risks and consequences of unregulated AI development.
The event highlights the growing need for AI regulation and oversight.
The protesters are calling for a more cautious approach to AI development, with a focus on safety and ethics.

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The call for AI regulation is becoming increasingly urgent, with many experts warning of the potential risks of unregulated AI development.
The protest highlights the need for a more nuanced and informed discussion about AI and its potential consequences.
